description.value: Bacayon's Chibugan is a Filipino takeout restaurant specializing in traditional home-style dishes and large party trays, with an extensive menu covering classic preparations like kare-kare, adobo, dinuguan, and a wide range of Filipino sweets. The business operates primarily as a pickup-order operation with online ordering available. A touring cyclist looking for a substantial, flavour-forward meal in the Surrey area would find a broad selection of rice, noodle, pork, chicken, and vegetable dishes.

bike_parking_detail: 4 racks within 100m: rack (4 spaces) at 26m; wall_loops (6 spaces) at 43m; stands (10 spaces) at 49m; rack (4 spaces) at 72m. Total: 24 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms the business name and cuisine (Filipino) and shows active online ordering for pickup with a 15-minute pickup time. However, a critical discrepancy exists: OSM places this business at 4560 Kingsway, Vancouver, while the website consistently lists the address as Unit 105 - 13979 104 Ave, Surrey, BC V3T1X1 across every page — these are different cities entirely. No cyclist-relevant amenities (bike parking, washrooms, Wi-Fi, etc.) are mentioned anywhere on the website.
concerns: Major address discrepancy: OSM records '4560 Kingsway, Vancouver' but website consistently shows 'Unit 105 - 13979 104 Ave, Surrey, BC V3T1X1' on every page. The business appears to be in Surrey, not Vancouver.
OSM node coordinates (49.2295453, -123.003179) correspond to the Kingsway/Vancouver area, not the Surrey address given on the website. The OSM record may refer to a former location or be misplaced.
OSM has no phone number; website-sourced phone (+1 604-585-9217) cannot be cross-confirmed against OSM.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: The OSM record places this business at 4560 Kingsway, Vancouver, but every page of the website consistently lists the address as Unit 105 - 13979 104 Ave, Surrey — a different city. The OSM node coordinates and address must be verified before this listing can be placed correctly in the directory.
enrichment_extras.notes: Website address used in preference to OSM address per rule 12, as the website shows a clearly different and current value. The community field in OSM is 'Vancouver' but the actual location per the website is Surrey.
